description:
Validate a JSON document against a JSON Schema (drafts 06, 07, 2019-09 and 2020-12, via Ajv, all errors reported with JSON Pointer paths and formats such as date-time, email, uuid, ipv4/ipv6 checked), or infer a starter schema from sample JSON. Leave `schema` empty to infer.

Returns: Validate: text summary plus structuredContent { mode, valid, draft, errors[{ path, message, keyword, schemaPath, params }], warnings[] }. Infer: the schema as JSON text and structuredContent { mode, schema }.
Example input: {"data":"{\"name\":\"Ada\",\"age\":-1}","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"age\":{\"type\":\"integer\",\"minimum\":0}},\"required\":[\"name\",\"email\"]}","draft":"auto"}
On error, includes hint: Both `data` and `schema` are JSON text, not objects. Send an empty `schema` to generate one from `data`.

data.description: The JSON document (as text) to validate, or the sample to infer a schema from.

draft.description: Draft for validation; auto reads $schema and defaults to 2020-12.

infer_draft.description: Draft of the generated schema when inferring.

infer_required.description: When inferring: all = keys present in every sampled object are required.

schema.description: The JSON Schema as text. Empty = infer a schema from `data` instead of validating.

name: json_schema_validate
title: JSON Schema validate or generate
